articles.title: Crypto IPOs could create massive $1 trillion market amid tokenization wave, Jefferies says
articles.snippet: The Wall Street investment bank expects a wave of crypto and blockchain public listings over the next two years as institutional investors shift their focus from speculative trading to real-world financial infrastructure.

articles.title: Block kicks off Cash App’s phased stablecoin roll out to its nearly 60 million users
articles.snippet: An individual familiar with the matter told CoinDesk the stablecoin feature was rolled out to 25% of users already and by the end of the week, all users will have access.

articles.title: Banca Sella gets green light to provide crypto services to customers in Italian first
articles.snippet: The fintech-forward private bank said it is the first Italian lender to get Bank of Italy approval under MiCA to offer digital asset custody and transfers.

articles.title: Singapore charges former Hodlnaut CEO Zhu Juntao over Terra collapse claims
articles.snippet: Zhu allegedly directed staff to publish false claims that Hodlnaut had no direct exposure to the TerraUSD collapse on Telegram and in customer emails.

articles.title: StakeDAO exploit creates 5.4 trillion vsdCRV but nets only $91K
articles.snippet: PeckShield said the attacker bridged 43.7 ETH to Ethereum after minting trillions of vsdCRV, while EmberCN said most of the remaining tokens had insufficient liquidity to sell.
